QuestInfo.name: [Esfera] Into the Mirror
QuestInfo.0: Melange is going to read Tana's memory formed in Mirror World. Listen to the details.
QuestInfo.1: Help Melange who analyzed the power of Mirror World to infiltrate Tana's memory. Take care of the nearby Executors for Melange to focus. Defeat around 200 #bLight Executors#k.
QuestInfo.2: It seems Tana arrived in this place to escape her destiny. But what is the reason for the Black Mage wanting Tana, who is the same #bTranscendent of Light#k as him?
